sentences.en: If he should hear the news, he would be shocked.
sentences.zh: 如果他听到这个消息，他会感到震惊。

sentences.en: The man glanced at the news program and was shocked.
sentences.zh: 那人瞥了一眼新闻节目，感到非常震惊。

sentences.en: He was shocked to hear that his daughter had shoplifted.
sentences.zh: 当他得知女儿偷窃时，他感到十分震惊。
